events.title: 애스턴 빌라 beat 노리치 시티 1–0 in the all-Second Division final of the League Cup at Wembley, ending their 14-year wait for a major trophy which began when they won the first ever League Cup.
Second Division 풀럼 beat 칼라일 유나이티드 1–0 in the FA Cup quarter-finals. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 버밍엄 시티 join them in the last four.
England beat world champions West Germany 2–0 in a friendly in their 100th international at Wembley.
울버햄프턴 원더러스 beat 첼시 7–1 in the biggest win of the First Division season. 입스위치 타운 beat 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 5–4, but 에버턴 now lead the table by three points from 번리 with a game in hand.
After three draws, 입스위치 타운 beat 리즈 유나이티드 3–2 in the third replay of their FA Cup quarter-final at Filbert Street .
에버턴 suffer a 3–0 defeat away to bottom-placed 칼라일 유나이티드, and relinquish top spot in the First Division to 리버풀.

에버턴 beat 코번트리 시티 1–0 to move back to the top of the table, as 리버풀 lose 2–0 to 스토크 시티. They lead 리버풀 and Stoke by one point with a game in hand, and have just five matches remaining, but 입스위치 타운, 더비 카운티 and 미들즈브러 also remain in contention. 토트넘 홋스퍼 have slipped back into the relegation zone alongside 칼라일 유나이티드 and 루턴 타운.
